name: KARLBench
description: KARLBench is a multi-capability evaluation suite spanning six distinct search regimes, including entity search, report synthesis, numerical reasoning, entity retrieval, procedural reasoning, and fact aggregation. It evaluates enterprise search agents on diverse, hard-to-verify tasks.
reputation: A specialized enterprise-search benchmark that is useful for evaluating multi-capability search agents, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Includes diverse search tasks with multi-task reinforcement learning evaluation; focuses on enterprise knowledge agents.
